description: Freshdesk support operations for triage, conversation review, ticket creation, updates, notes, and replies. Read actions are non-mutating; every write is declared external so RailCall stages preview, human approval, execution, and receipt.

commands.name: freshdesk.list_tickets
commands.title: List Freshdesk tickets
commands.description: List tickets with bounded pagination and optional status filter.

commands.name: freshdesk.get_ticket
commands.title: Get Freshdesk ticket
commands.description: Fetch one ticket by numeric ticket id.

commands.name: freshdesk.search_tickets
commands.title: Search Freshdesk tickets
commands.description: Run a Freshdesk ticket search query with bounded pagination.

commands.name: freshdesk.list_conversations
commands.title: List ticket conversations
commands.description: List conversations for a Freshdesk ticket.

commands.name: freshdesk.create_ticket
commands.title: Create Freshdesk ticket
commands.description: Create a support ticket after RailCall approval.

commands.name: freshdesk.update_ticket
commands.title: Update Freshdesk ticket
commands.description: Update selected mutable ticket fields after RailCall approval.

commands.name: freshdesk.add_note
commands.title: Add Freshdesk note
commands.description: Add a private or public note to a ticket after RailCall approval.

commands.name: freshdesk.reply_ticket
commands.title: Reply to Freshdesk ticket
commands.description: Send a ticket reply after RailCall approval.
